name: Slipmat
description: Self-hosted control and automation for a Sonos system, entirely over your local network: no cloud and no Sonos account. A web UI for everyday playback and grouping, plus presets that group speakers, set their volumes and play a shuffled mix of playlists, albums and favourites. Fire presets from the UI, a webhook (Shortcuts, Stream Deck, Node-RED) or an optional HomeKit switch. Host networking is required: Sonos discovery is multicast and the speakers call back into Slipmat for live updates, neither of which crosses a bridge network.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Presets, schedules, settings and the source cache (a small SQLite database), plus HomeKit pairing data if enabled.

variables.name: Web UI port
variables.description: Port the web UI and API listen on. With host networking this is a port on the Unraid server itself.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Optional. Setting a password turns on login for the web UI and API. Webhooks keep working through their own secret URLs either way.

variables.name: Allowed hostnames
variables.description: Comma-separated hostnames you reach Slipmat by, such as a domain behind a reverse proxy. IP addresses, localhost, *.local and *.ts.net always work; anything else is refused to block DNS rebinding.

variables.name: Speaker IP
variables.description: Optional. The IP of any one speaker, for networks where discovery can't get through (VLANs, multicast filtering). Slipmat finds the rest of the system from it.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: Optional IANA time zone (for example Europe/London) for schedules and time-based rules. Defaults to the container's time zone, and can also be changed in Settings.

variables.name: HomeKit bridge
variables.description: Set to 1 to expose presets as HomeKit switches.

variables.name: HomeKit PIN
variables.description: Optional pairing code for the HomeKit bridge, in the form 123-45-678. Left blank, one is generated on first run and shown in Settings.

variables.name: HomeKit name
variables.description: Name of the bridge as it appears in the Home app.

variables.name: Callback address
variables.description: Optional. The server address speakers should send live updates to, when the server has several network interfaces and Slipmat guesses the wrong one.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: One of trace, debug, info, warn, error.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the server runs as. /data is handed to this user on start.
